rationale: The evaluator feedback suggested reducing kp from 0.9 to 0.7 to potentially reduce oscillations, increasing the middle sensor weight from 0.6 to 0.7 to improve sensitivity and stability balance, and confirming the line_loss strategy as 'last_direction' to enhance line recovery. I implemented these changes accordingly. The sensor_weights now have the middle sensor at 0.7, outer sensors at -0.7 (less negative than before to reduce overcorrection), and line_loss is set to 'last_direction'. Sensor size remains at 0.016 to maintain noise robustness. I expect these changes to reduce steering oscillations, improve line tracking stability, and enhance recovery from line loss events. The requested measurements include line_loss_events and steering_oscillation to verify these hypotheses in the next telemetry.
